verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Slack-native AI SRE that investigates incidents and suggests hypotheses, plus an automated post-mortem generated after the fact from the timeline and Slack. Neither is live incident scribing: nothing documents real-time incident summaries, AI-drafted stakeholder or status updates, or transcribed call notes. Post-incident write-ups and investigation help are adjacent capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing
